identity.failed_instruction: Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.

source.text: 5 wrong answers in total end the check (was 4). (7 October, point 1, confirmed by Compliance 9 October) / the API's `wrong_answers_left` is the count to use. / Ask once more; if it is still unclear after the second ask, close as `not_reached` / `unclear`. / If the customer declines to answer or asks what the call is about before answering, explain once that the questions protect their account. A second refusal closes as `not_verified` / `declined`.

4. Callbacks: today or the next business day. (7 October, overrides 'next business day only, never today') / from 10:00 to 17:30, both included, and later than `now`. ... close as `not_reached` / `callback`. / If the person names a time outside that window, say so and ask once more. If no valid time results, close as `not_reached` / `no_callback`.

third_party.deceased_sentence: I am sorry for your loss.

source.text: Someone other than the customer (relative, colleague, friend): say nothing about the purpose. Ask when the customer can be reached. / Wrong number: apologise and close as `not_reached` / `wrong_number`. The customer has died: say "I am sorry for your loss." and close as `not_reached` / `deceased`.

Use the call variable `now` as the clock, never the machine clock. Business days are Monday to Saturday, except Bank 11 holidays: 2026-10-14, 2026-10-15. "Next <weekday>" means that weekday of the following week, even when today is that weekday; "this <weekday>" means the coming one.

2. Days late 1–90: the deadline is the twelfth business day after today (no longer the sixth business day). / | 1 to 90 | band1 | ... | 2 | / Attempt 1: propose the full past-due amount on the last business day of this week; if today is that day, the last business day of next week. If the customer already said the full amount is too much, attempt 1 proposes the floor instead. Attempt 2: propose the floor amount on the deadline.

Ask for the full past-due amount first. Never ask "how much can you pay?". Any amount between the floor and the full amount is accepted; an amount below the floor is refused, and the floor is offered once per product with the words "the rest stays overdue".

A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline. A weekend day or holiday rolls to the next business day. A vague date ...: ask once for the exact day; if none follows, propose the deadline. A date after the deadline: offer the deadline instead.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: The customer says they have already paid the overdue amount.
special_cases.say: Payments can take one business day to appear.

source.text: 25. Already paid: say "Payments can take one business day to appear.". Close as `paid`.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer says it is not their debt, they never had the product, or it was closed or paid off before.

source.text: 26. Dispute (not their debt, never had the product, closed or paid off before): close as `no_promise` / `dispute`.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer mentions hardship such as illness, a death in the family, or job loss.
special_cases.say: I am sorry to hear that.

source.text: 27. Hardship (illness, a death in the family, job loss): say one short sentence of sympathy, make no persuasion attempt, and offer a transfer to the `support` team. If they accept, call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `support` and close as `transferred` / `support`. If they decline, close as `no_promise` / `hardship`. A customer in hardship may still name a date and amount; record it.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks for a payment plan, lower instalments, or changing the terms.

source.text: 28. Restructuring (a payment plan, lower instalments, changing the terms): call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `restructuring` and close as `transferred` / `restructuring`. Promises already recorded on this call stay recorded.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a human agent, during or after the identity check.

source.text: Human requests: transfer immediately, do not ask whether you can help. (7 October, point 4, overrides rules 15 and 29) / call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `general` and close as `transferred` / `human`.

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer suspects the call is a scam.
special_cases.say: You can verify this call by phoning Bank 11's customer service number.

source.text: If the person suspects a scam: say they can verify the call by phoning Bank 11's customer service number, and continue.

special_cases.name: robot
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether they are talking to a robot.

source.text: If asked whether this is a robot: say "I am Bank 11's digital assistant."
10. The customer refuses to talk: close as `no_promise` / `refused`.

source.text: 36. Thank the customer and say goodbye before `close_call`, which is the last tool call. / 37. At least one promise recorded: `promise`. A transfer: `transferred` with the transfer's reason, even after a promise. Already paid: `paid`. No promise: `no_promise` with the reason that applies.
35. `add_note` is never used.
`get_account` returns up to 1 product. / 34. A customer has one product; the rules above apply to it alone.

source.text: First sentence: say you are the automated assistant of Bank 11 and that the call is recorded. Then ask whether you are speaking with the customer, using title and last name. / Before the identity check is complete, never say the words collections, debt, payment, credit card or loan / After verification say you are calling from the Bank 11 collections team about a late payment. ... then ask "Can you make this payment today?". / `credit_card` (say "credit card") ... `personal_loan` (say "personal loan") ... `car_loan` (say "car loan")

Correction to Operations' message of 7 October, point 3 only: after a failed create_promise the agent must NOT retry; the service-error outcome applies after the first failure. (9 October Compliance, overrides 7 October point 3 'retry 2 times') / Read the product, the amount and the date back and ask "Do you confirm?". ... one promise per product.

unresolved.text: The documents do not dictate a sentence for questions the agent cannot answer. (On create_promise failure they only say: say you could not record it and close as no_promise / service_error.)
Customers have only one product, so no question for several products is defined.
The documents do not mention the verify_identity hint (day_month_swapped); no date question is used, so no hint reply is defined.
The documents do not say how to resolve a promise date given without a month or year; only vague dates (ask once, then propose the deadline) are covered.
